subject.title: [Bug]: Unscheduled reminder guard fires for isolated-session crons + counter lost during compaction

question: Should maintainers adopt the open conflicting fork PR for this issue, replace it with a fresh target-repo fix, or keep waiting on that branch?
rationale: The bug is source-reproducible and small, but the issue is already linked to an open PR with closing syntax and ClawSweeper should not create a competing fix PR without maintainer direction.

options.title: Replace with fresh target-repo fix
options.body: Open a new narrow PR against current main that uses the proven fix shape without inheriting the stale conflicting fork branch.

options.title: Adopt the fork PR
options.body: Ask the contributor or a maintainer to rebase and adapt the existing fork PR to current files and proof requirements.

options.title: Keep waiting on the fork PR
options.body: Leave this issue blocked on the existing open fork PR until that branch becomes viable or is closed.

recommendation.title: Replace with fresh target-repo fix
recommendation.body: Open a new narrow PR against current main that uses the proven fix shape without inheriting the stale conflicting fork branch.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the merged predecessor behavior that this issue extends, making them the strongest code-history routing candidate.
